prompt:
Create one landscape PNG raster illustration, native approximately 16:9 (about 1672 x 941). Friendly, warm, clear abstract hand-drawn comic style matching SkillPilot science learning illustrations: soft cream/pale blue background, rounded dark-blue outlines, a few generous colorful shapes and calm composition. Scientifically sound, never photorealistic, never sterile technical CAD. Main idea and critical details must remain clear at 360px total displayed width, and at 680px. No tiny letters, decorative writing, equations, logos, watermark, caption or textual labels. Use large motifs, sufficient white space. This is an author candidate, not quality approval. 
Actual bilingual learning-goal context (do not typeset this): Missbrauch der Evolutionstheorie analysieren — Die lernende Person kann historische Beispiele wie den Nationalsozialismus kritisch einordnen. / Analyze the misuse of evolutionary theory — The learner can critically classify historical examples like National Socialism.
Scene: Create an educational, critical illustration of historical misuse of evolutionary theory, such as National Socialism, in a present-day archive/classroom. Two thoughtful adult learners examine a large historical folder on a desk; the cover bears only one clear, large date range 1933–1945. On its open page a simplistic hierarchy ladder of identical generic human silhouettes is visibly crossed out by a thick red X: this is a rejected ideological value ranking, not accepted biological science. No depiction of ethnic groups as different evolutionary species or levels, no hateful slogans, swastikas, flags or glorification. To the right show a separate large calm panel of several diverse modern adult people standing side by side at the same level, with a simple balanced justice scale, representing equal human dignity. Keep the archive illustration and rights panel distinct: do not draw an arrow deriving moral value from evolution. The learners use a large magnifying glass over the erroneous historical diagram as a symbol of critical scrutiny. Serious and respectful while retaining the warm friendly comic aesthetic. Main message rejection of ideological ranking clear even without reading the date. Orient the actual document and diagram towards the people studying it, not upside down to them.
